verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to a cloud provider. However, no first-party documentation in the pack describes a published region list or a per-region service availability table. Community posts mention the us-east-1 region only in the context of outages, which does not show a documented list or availability check users can consult before committing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can pick where things run — a published region list with per-region service availability I can check before committing
